text:
maggie: Heads up — shelf telemetry spike in rack-42 (usw1-rack18). saw abrupt egress error rate x6 since 09:12 UTC. Requesting quick quarantine of any noisy tenants on shelf 42.
arnav: Can you paste the logs? is this NVLink or NIC? :eyes:
maggie: snippet: ```2026-03-22T09:12:14Z INFO egress_packets=6123 drop=228 ifindex=eth0 tx_errors=210 pcie_io_err=5``` Suspect pcie->nic bounce. RTT tail rising.
liam: I see matching telemetry — kvcache miss rate up, threads bumping. Probably one tenant doing parallel prep jobs.
nana: tenant map shows t-743 and t-982 on slot 7/8 — t-743 has large batch-prep. @jin can we soft-quarantine t-743 to a fractional pool? doesn't require dedicated SLA.
jin: we can do ephemeral carveout. Command: `infractl allocate --shelf rack18 --tenant t-743 --mode fractional --ttl 30m --nodes 2`
arnav: before carving out, try routing only egress-heavy ports away: `proxyctl reroute --from rack18 --filter 'dst_port>=30000' --to warmpool-usw1` to reduce NVMe pressure.
maggie: tried reroute, partial success. drop rate down ~30% but tails persist. carveout next.
ops-bot: action queued: allocate fractional pool for t-743 (job id 9921). ETA ~4m.
liam: cost note — fractional carveout will bump TCUs ~+0.8 for the window. Track for chargeback and tag it.
nana: set sweeper to release after 30m if no errors: `sweeperctl schedule release-ephemeral 9921 --if-no-errors 30m`
arnav: also add temporary flow-monitor rule: `flowmon add --name rack18-spill --thresh 100pps --notify #eng-infra`
maggie: can you watch for reappearance of `pcie_io_err` on node-42-1? I'll run continuity probes.
liam: quick triage: a kernel queue stall patch looks promising — canary patch to rack18 nodes now. `deploy-bot` please roll canary.
deploy-bot: canary patch queued on node-42-1 -> node-42-2. Reporting in 6m.
arnav: fallback plan if kernel patch doesn't stick: preempt t-743 onto a dedicated slice (SLA talk) or enforce qos-tag throttling.
jin: i'll watch the carveout and attach tag `ephemeral-noise` to job 9921 for accounting.
maggie: thanks. if tail latency > 400ms post-fix, ping @oncall-sre immediately.
liam: noted. pinged finance for temporary overage awareness.
nana: post-incident checklist: capture pcap from node-42-1, collect flowmon logs and tenant histograms. I'll start archiving.
ops-bot: allocated fractional pool 9921 complete.
maggie: carve successful, initial error drop ~65%. Leaving sweeper on 30m. Closing unless it recurs. :thumbsup:
